title: Bridging the Multilingual Safety Divide: Efficient, Culturally-Aware Alignment for Global South Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating safety failure rates, jailbreak attack success rates, and the propagation of factual knowledge edits across high-, medium-, and low-resource languages, as well as code-mixed inputs, using the multilingual XThreatBench benchmark.

Evaluating model outputs against a dataset spanning 11 cultures and 11 societal domains to detect subtle cultural harms, such as biased generalizations, dismissive portrayals of local customs, and one-sided framings, utilizing judgments from culturally grounded local annotators.
